Question
========



```{r results = "hide"}
news_file <- "newsanchor1.rds"
papers_file <- "papers_query_crossref.rds"
include_supplement(file = c(news_file, papers_file),
           recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
news <- read_rds(news_file)

news_df <-
  news$results_df %>% 
  select(author, title, url, name) %>% 
  sample_n(nrow(.)) %>% 
  mutate(type = "news",
         id = row_number()) 

```



```{r read-news}
papers <- read_rds(papers_file)

papers_df <-
  papers %>% 
  sample_n(nrow(.)) %>% 
  select(author = family_names, title, url, name = short.container.title) %>% 
  mutate(type = "journal-article",
         id = row_number()) 
```


```{r read-journal-articles}
pubs <-
  news_df %>% 
  bind_rows(papers_df)
```


```{r draw-sample}
items_df <- 
  pubs %>% 
  filter(((type == "journal-article") & id == 1) | # one journal article
          (type == "news") & id %in% c(1:4)) %>%  # 4 news articles
  mutate(id_sample = row_number()) %>% 
  select(id_sample, author, title, url, name, type) %>% 
  mutate(selected = ifelse(type == "journal-article", TRUE, FALSE))
```


```{r testthat}
stopifnot(sum(items_df$selected) == 1)
stopifnot(nrow(items_df) == 5)
```



Im Folgenden sind einige Publikationen dargestellt. 
Welche Publikationen ist am ehesten ein Fachartikel?

Wählen Sie diese Publikation aus (d.h. die entsprechende Nummer)!


```{r}
items_df %>% 
  select(id_sample, author, title, url) %>% 
  gt()
```



```{r}
items <- items_df %>% 
  pull(id_sample)
```



```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(items, markup = "markdown")
```


Solution
========

Dieser Artikel ist am ehesten ein Fachartikel:

```{r}
items_df %>% 
  filter(type == "journal-article") %>% 
  select(id_sample, author, title, url) %>% 
  gt()
```




Richtige Lösung:


Aufgabenname: `papers-qualitaet-einschaetzen`


```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(items_df$selected, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```


Meta-information
================

extype: schoice
